title: Choose the visual world for Tip-Off Desk
question: Four worlds for the live app (Edge Board, Card, Ledger, Rulebook, phone news view). Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Road Uniforms
options.lineage: NBA uniform design: tackle-twill numbers, side-panel piping, jock tags
options.thesis: Every game on the slate wears its two teams' colors, and the card you lock is stitched like a jersey back.
options.viewport: Road-navy left rail with a gold piping stripe; Edge Board rows grouped by game, each game header piped in both teams' colors; the Hard Rock price set in outlined twill numerals beside the muted fair price; tonight's card docked right.
options.risk: Team colors can become a costume party: piping must stay a thin, functional stripe and twill numerals only go on the few numbers that matter.

raised.raise: Every chart and sparkline sits on one fixed scale, so any two nights compare at a glance.
Every edge number opens to its proof: the books, the de-vig, the fair price.
One work area owns each screen; everything else steps back.
Focusing a market pulls its numbers forward while the rest of the board recedes.

options.label: Hardwood
options.lineage: the painted NBA court: maple, lane lines, the key, the arc
options.thesis: The court is the grid, and the edge threshold is drawn as the three-point line.
options.viewport: Maple header rail; the board ruled with lane lines; above it, tonight's markets plotted as shots with the 2% edge threshold drawn as the arc, so what clears sits outside it.
options.risk: Familiar: court texture is where most sports apps land, and wood grain turns kitsch fast.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets fused with sportsbook tickets
options.thesis: The night's card is a coupon book: each leg validates at lock and stamps WON, LOST or VOID; nothing disappears, it cancels.
options.viewport: Edge Board table on the left; on the right a coupon book, one coupon per leg with HR price and stake struck in carbon numerals, the lock control at its foot.
options.case: Its states map exactly onto bets (locked, graded, void), so clarity is strongest; identity is weaker, since it is travel ephemera, not basketball.
options.risk: Paper skeuomorphism can turn costume-y on a working table.

options.label: Timetable
options.lineage: 1970s pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: Tonight's slate set like a departures timetable: one type size, rank carried by weight, case and reversal.
options.viewport: Games as departures ordered by tip time, each market a row; the Hard Rock price column reversed out of a carbon plate; the card as one opaque slide.
options.case: Tip times and prices read naturally as a timetable, so clarity holds; it reads as an airline, not the NBA.
options.risk: The one-size rule and goldenrod ground fight dense tables if executed timidly.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One subject followed through stages at a fixed scale.
options.case: Bettors do not identify with it, and plates fight dense tables.
options.kept: One fixed scale across every chart.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.case: A marketing form on a working tool; generic identity.
options.kept: Every number opens to its proof.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: One swelling lobe of color owns each screen.
options.case: Playful map forms obscure tables and state.
options.kept: One work area owns each screen.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Dense mono columns in pure black and white.
options.case: No color for state, and no basketball identity.
options.kept: Focus pulls numbers forward; the field recedes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What odds tools ship, executed impeccably: a dark dashboard of tables with green and red numbers.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, filter row, dense odds table, card panel on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other odds tool by design.
